Mine Mayhem (Japanese: VS ドリュウズ VS Excadrill), titled VS Excadrill in the Shogakukan Asia translation, is the 492nd chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 32nd chapter of the .

It is subtitled Excadrill (Japanese: 出土 Excavation) in the VIZ Media translation and Mine Mayhem in the Shogakukan Asia translation.
